sources.claim: The ticket requires listing shared and local environments, retrieving, creating, and modifying environments via the MCP server.
The functional requirements FR-001..FR-013 define the environment list/read/create/modify actions and their constraints.
The modify action uses PATCH partial-merge so remote_agents is preserved; the method is named modify_environment.
Create uses POST with a typed request model serialized by_alias and exclude_none, mirroring schedule_manager.create.
The single environments tool is extended via match-action routing; shared vs local routed by test_id; auth/consent inherited; limits surfaced via http_error_message.
Design alternatives compare PATCH partial-merge (selected) against PUT wholesale (rejected) and a separate tool (rejected).
Runtime Data Availability Proof shows every required datum is available at read time; the api PATCH merges server-side.
Cross-Service Contract Verification confirms the shared/local/single environment endpoints, PATCH partial-merge, and inherited ai_consent gating from static api source.
The task list defines setup, per-story failing tests, implementations, and polish for every action and error path.
The scenario table and planner hard-gate scenarios cover each action, the partial-merge falsification, negative paths, and the no-delete guard.
The Requirement Traceability Matrix maps each AC to FR/SC, tasks, and a test name.
